theorems.name: Submission.weighted_mono_cutoff_integral_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (f : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (t R : ℝ) (φ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < t → IntegrableOn f (closedBall ξ R) μ → Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ m, (1 + ε m) * t ≤ R) → (∀ m, Measurable (φ m)) → (∀ m s, 0 ≤ φ m s ∧ φ m s ≤ 1) → (∀ m s, s ≤ 1 → φ m s = 1) → (∀ m s, 1 + ε m ≤ s → φ m s = 0) → Tendsto (fun m ↦ ∫ x, φ m (‖x - ξ‖ / t) * f x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in closedBall ξ t, f x ∂μ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
